€550/month + VAT

Calle Eduardo Torroja, 3 – La Luz, Málaga

A perfect opportunity for entrepreneurs who want to start their business without making a large initial investment!

Commercial stall of approximately 7 m2 for rent, located inside a neighborhood shopping arcade, surrounded by homes and traditional businesses.

✨ FEATURES:

Approximate area of 7 m2.
Wide commercial frontage of 4 meters.
Depth of 1.75 m and height of 2.50 m.
Refrigerated cold storage unit.
Two electronic scales.
Water heater.
Queue management display.
Former fishmonger's stall, with equipment that can be used for food-related activities.

� LOCATION:

️ Located in a well-established residential area of La Luz, in the Carretera de Cádiz district.
️ Inside a shopping arcade with traditional food businesses.
Surrounded by local shops and services.
Arcade with access from two streets.

IDEAL FOR: Fishmonger, sale of fresh products, specialized food, or other businesses compatible with the space.

SET UP YOUR BUSINESS FOR ONLY €550 + VAT PER MONTH!

Call us and come see it!
